classification: 3+1D free Minkowski vacuum spherical partial-wave reconstruction and Ellis infrared variational test
dimension: field two-point function in natural units m^-2, NOT renormalized energy density
integration: composite Simpson k integral with fixed finite cutoff; stable upward/downward spherical Bessel recurrence; independent direct-spectrum and exact closed-form comparisons
angular_truncation: finite ell_max in [0,40], numerical sensitivity only, no rigorous global tail bound
ellis_ir_packet: radial smooth bump of width W centered at 12W on one asymptotic end of complete Ellis slice
spectral_statement: -Delta_h nonnegative with inf spectrum 0; no strictly positive spectral gap established by smooth compact variational trial sequence

sources.bessel_reference: NIST DLMF §10.60 spherical-Bessel addition theorems https://dlmf.nist.gov/10.60
